scope: Read-only Git topology and currently installed source workflow surfaces.

authority.rule: GitHub is a relay/projection and must not replace Forgejo runtime/source authority.

evidence: source_sync observation hard-codes remote name forgejo while the actual sovereign remote is ssot
source_sync compares main with forgejo/main rather than the configured sovereign ref
installed cynic binary does not expose source command
CLI release handler runs gate only
dry_run and apply arguments are currently unused by release execution
large ahead count emits archive plus force-push plan without merge-base classification or protected relay manifest
current relationship is divergent, not fast-forward

worktree_observation.release_gate_implication: blocked: existing release gate requires a clean worktree

required_workflow.research: Question, versioned sources, hypotheses, contradictions, measurements, and evidence references are retained before design claims.
required_workflow.plan: Every non-trivial change answers Where, What, How, Why; names owner, alternatives, policy/safety risk, test, read-back, and rollback intent.
required_workflow.hitl: Required for trust-boundary, secret, public, network/TLS/DNS, divergent-history, or externally mutating changes; admission binds plan digest, scope, budget, duration, and stop conditions.
required_workflow.execution: Claimed or explicit human-scoped fallback, isolated worktree, tests/proofs, explicit-path commit, and external state read-back.
required_workflow.promotion: Forgejo acceptance/read-back precedes GitHub relay plan; divergent relay history is integrated or explicitly archived, never force-pushed by count alone.
required_workflow.learning: User corrections and failed read-backs become a typed gap, regression proof, and maintained skill/contract update.

residual_unknowns: Forgejo/GitHub branch protection and pull-request policy were not observed in this slice.
No canonical runtime artifact currently proves the source workflow CLI surface.
MCP coordination remains removed/incompatible and cannot issue mutation claims.
